sources.description: Even though his latest superb showing came against significantly inferior opposition in the form of the Miami Dolphins, the excitement around what 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy has put together through the opening two weeks of the season is understandable. Purdy was near-perfect in the 49ers’ 35-13 rout of the rebuilding Dolphins, rewriting several pages of […]
